name: 9050 Red Branch Road
thesis: Oxford's largest Maryland asset. Acquired stabilized with slightly below-market rents; active management has grown income with minimal turnover.

detail.metaDescription: 9050 Red Branch Road: 90,000 SF industrial/flex building in Columbia, MD, owned and operated by Oxford Realty Advisors with permanent, proprietary capital.
summary: At 90,000 SF, 9050 Red Branch Road is Oxford's largest Maryland asset. Oxford acquired it stabilized, with rents slightly below market.
Turnover has been minimal. Active management has grown the building's income, and Oxford has declined purchase offers in favor of continued rent growth.
highlights: Acquired stabilized with slightly below-market rents
Held for continued rent growth rather than sold
specs: Truck-high docks; some units also have ramps for drive-in access

name: 3540 E Fifth Avenue
thesis: A functionally obsolete truck repair facility, repositioned with a full renovation and leased long-term to a global fragrance manufacturer.

detail.metaDescription: 3540 E Fifth Avenue: 36,000 SF industrial building in Columbus, OH, repositioned by Oxford Realty Advisors from a functionally obsolete truck repair facility.
summary: 3540 E Fifth Avenue began as a functionally obsolete truck repair facility. Oxford repositioned it with a new metal building skin, roof replacement, full asphalt milling and repaving, overhead door replacements, a complete office rebuild and upgraded HVAC systems.
The project also addressed environmental challenges, coordinating with the Ohio EPA on vapor mitigation systems. Oxford then executed a 10-year lease with a global fragrance manufacturer.
highlights: Environmental work coordinated with the Ohio EPA
10-year lease with a global fragrance manufacturer
specs: Rear and side; truck-high docks and at-grade drive-in
About 6 acres, near Columbus International Airport
